## Game rules

- 5 reels x 4 rows, 1,024 ways, wins pay left to right on adjacent reels, 3+ of a kind.
- Wild (reels 2–4) substitutes for all pay symbols.
- **Climbing Wilds:** 1 in 130 base rounds, 1/2/3 of reels 2–4 turn fully wild (weights 90/9/1).
- **Summit Free Spins:** 3/4/5 scatters pay 1/5/25x and award 8/12/20 free spins on separate reels. Each wild landed adds +1x to a persistent multiplier (max 10x). 3+ scatters retrigger +5 spins.
- **Treasure Hold & Win:** 6+ coins in a base round lock and award 3 respins. Each empty cell spins a single-cell strip of 1 coin : 34 blanks. A new coin resets respins. Filling all 20 cells adds the Grand (1000x).
- Total round win is capped at 5,000x the bet.
